title: Script Finder-No Key
features:
Here are the features of the Mobile Script Finder (LightningHub) Roblox Lua script:
 ScriptBlox Integration: Automatically detects the name or ⁠PlaceId⁠ of the game you are playing and fetches related scripts directly from ScriptBlox services.
 Persistent Favorites System: Allows you to add or remove scripts to and from your favorites. Data is saved locally on your device in ⁠.json⁠ format using ⁠writefile⁠ and ⁠readfile⁠.
 UI & Usability:
 Features a draggable main panel and a toggle button in the top-left corner for easy access.
 Designed with a compact, mobile-friendly layout.
 Quick Action Buttons:
 ▶ Run: Directly executes scripts in-game using ⁠loadstring⁠.
 📋 Copy: Copies the script code to your clipboard via ⁠setclipboard⁠.
 ⭐ Favorites Tab: Lets you seamlessly switch between your saved favorite scripts and the full list of scripts for the game.
 Key Indicator: Automatically appends a ⁠KEY 🔑⁠ tag to script titles that require an access key.
 Error Handling & Feedback: Provides instant visual feedback on buttons (such as ⁠✅⁠, ⁠❌⁠, or ⁠⚠️ ErrorLight⁠) when executing or copying scripts.
